summary: NextSync 0.2.1: the folder picker opens at its default location unless a real folder is configured.
changelog: Fixed the folder picker: it no longer forces a hardcoded initial path. It opens at the file chooser's default location unless the pre-filled path is an existing directory, matching the file chooser behavior of the official client.
Multiple sync folders per account (from 0.2.0) remain the current model: accounts hold a list of folder pairs, and the setup wizard lets you finish without any folder.
